title: The Clean Safehouse Anew
author: Yara Ishikawa
blurb: Xanthe Thackeray, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must burn the network that did the training, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
